  • 24-ounce insulated stainless-steel FreeSip spout water bottle with your favorite Disney Princess
  • Patented FreeSip spout designed for either sipping upright through the built-in straw or tilting back to swig from the spout opening

Product Description

The Owala FreeSip Insulated Stainless-Steel Water Bottle with Locking Push-Button Lid easily tackles every thirst. With a built-in, easy-clean straw and a wide-mouth opening, the FreeSip reusable bottle is designed for drinking two different ways: sipping upright through the straw or tilting back to swig from the wide-mouth spout opening. Add in a push-to-open lid and Disney Princess themes, and staying hydrated has never been simpler—or more fun. Additional features include double-wall insulated stainless steel that keeps drinks cold up to 24 hours, a carry loop that doubles as a lock, a cup holder-friendly base, and a wide opening for easy cleaning and adding ice. The Owala FreeSip Insulated Stainless-Steel Water Bottle with Locking Push-Button Lid is available in five colors. Lid is dishwasher safe; hand wash cup. Not for use with hot liquids. Manufacturer’s limited lifetime warranty.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Desde el primer momento destaca por el diseño: los detalles inspirados en Star Wars están increíblemente bien logrados y hacen que se vea mucho más especial que una botella común. Tanto si eres fan casual como coleccionista, definitivamente llama la atención.

    Pero lo mejor es que no solo se ve increíble, también funciona excelente. El sistema FreeSip es probablemente lo más cómodo que he probado en una botella de agua. Poder elegir entre beber con popote integrado o tomar directamente inclinando la botella parece algo simple, pero en el uso diario hace muchísima diferencia. Es práctico para el gimnasio, oficina, coche o simplemente para traerla todo el día.

    La calidad de construcción también es excelente. Se siente resistente, bien sellada y hecha con materiales premium. La tapa cierra perfectamente y hasta ahora no he tenido ninguna fuga, incluso llevándola dentro de mochila.

    Otro punto impresionante es el aislamiento térmico. Mantiene el agua fría durante muchísimas horas, incluso en días calurosos. De verdad cumple lo que promete y hace que siempre tengas bebidas frías disponibles.

    Además, el tamaño y el agarre son muy cómodos. No se siente aparatosa y el asa integrada facilita muchísimo transportarla. Son pequeños detalles que terminan haciendo una gran diferencia en el día a día.

    Algo que me gustó mucho es que logra equilibrar perfectamente lo coleccionable con lo funcional. Muchas veces los productos temáticos sacrifican calidad por diseño, pero aquí ambas cosas están muy bien cuidadas.

About this Item

  • 24-ounce insulated stainless-steel FreeSip spout water bottle with your favorite Disney Princess
  • Patented FreeSip spout designed for either sipping upright through the built-in straw or tilting back to swig from the spout opening
  • Protective push-to-open lid keeps spout clean; convenient carry loop doubles as a lock
  • Double-wall insulation keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours; wide opening for cleaning and adding ice; cup holder-friendly base
  • BPA and phthalate-free; hand wash cup, dishwasher-safe lid; not for use with hot liquids

Product Description

The Owala FreeSip Insulated Stainless-Steel Water Bottle with Locking Push-Button Lid easily tackles every thirst. With a built-in, easy-clean straw and a wide-mouth opening, the FreeSip reusable bottle is designed for drinking two different ways: sipping upright through the straw or tilting back to swig from the wide-mouth spout opening. Add in a push-to-open lid and Disney Princess themes, and staying hydrated has never been simpler—or more fun. Additional features include double-wall insulated stainless steel that keeps drinks cold up to 24 hours, a carry loop that doubles as a lock, a cup holder-friendly base, and a wide opening for easy cleaning and adding ice. The Owala FreeSip Insulated Stainless-Steel Water Bottle with Locking Push-Button Lid is available in five colors. Lid is dishwasher safe; hand wash cup. Not for use with hot liquids. Manufacturer’s limited lifetime warranty.
